scripts.build: rm -rf web/dist && bun build web/index.html --outdir web/dist --production && bun scripts/fonts.ts copy web/dist/fonts
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex1 && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex2 && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex3 && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex4 && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex4/tsconfig.without-tests.json && tsc --noEmit -p test/added-plugins/ex5 && tsc --noEmit -p test/type-checks/unowned-names
scripts.build:engine: bun build web/src/engine/engine.ts --target browser --format iife --minify --outfile internal/engine/engine.js
